messages:
erin: Kicking off a Q2 scenario-planning thread for Hosted inference. Need to pick the top 2 portfolio slices we double-down on (chat latency, compact embeddings, rerank SLA). I sketched three scenarios below and a proposed acceptance matrix. Please react and add constraints.

devin: Capacity first: current Dedicated pool is oversubscribed in us-west at peak. We can't add 2x replicas for every experiment without a commit. Suggest we plan one low-latency canary and one efficiency experiment.

alex: From infra side, efficiency experiment = quantized embeddings + smarter batching. Early bench: int8 embeddings reduce mem 2.7x, CPU/GPU token cost down 30%. Latency hit ~5-12ms on average; still within search tolerances for many customers.

sam: OKR framing: if we prioritize low-latency chat we should target p95 <= 150ms for 512-token chat for hosted tier and cost < $0.30 per 1k tokens. For embeddings, target p99 <= 350ms for 768-d vectors and accuracy drop < 2% on sentinel eval set.

anya: Two customer asks to surface: Acme wants faster semantic search (embeddings), Nexus wants rerank deterministic SLAs for e-commerce ranking. Both would pay for dedicated if we can promise SLOs and rollout windows.

erin: Proposal: pick one 'latency-first' experiment and one 'cost-efficiency' experiment. Timeline: 6-week sprint to prototype -> 2-week internal canary -> 4-week customer canary. Acceptance criteria below.

devin: Flag: for the latency-first experiment we need compiler/kernel tweaks (attention fusion) + smaller sequence-optimized model variant. That impacts model catalog and model routing. Ops cost estimate: ~400 GPU-hours for dev/canary.

alex: Ops plan sketch (canary):
```
1) Internal canary: route 0.5% traffic to latency-optimized model variant in hosted-us-west.
2) Monitor p95/p99, errors, cost delta.
3) If metrics green for 48h, escalate to 5% for 7d.
4) Customer canary: enable for Acme or Nexus at 1-5% traffic with SLA contract.
```

sam: Acceptance matrix (suggested):
- Latency-first: p95 <= 150ms AND p99 <= 420ms for 512 tokens; semantic quality (chat eval) delta <= 1.5% relative to baseline.
- Embeddings-efficiency: recall@10 drop <= 2% AND p99 <= 350ms AND cost/token reduced >= 25%.
- Rerank SLA: end-to-end latency p95 <= 200ms and deterministic fallback to cheaper reranker within 50ms on overload.

anya: Tradeoffs to note: quantization can change embedding geometry for long-tail queries. We should add targeted eval slices: user-defined stopwords, multilingual queries, short vs long queries.

erin: Good call. Add eval harness tickets: EVAL-130 (multilingual embeddings), EVAL-131 (short-query recall), EVAL-132 (rerank A/B historical logs re-run).

devin: Ops ask: need a gating policy for capacity. If internal canary pushes GPU util > 88% for > 15m we auto-scale down canary or fallback to baseline model. Add autoscaler rule.

alex: Suggested config snippet for batcher:
```
batcher:
  max_batch_size: 64
  latency_slo_ms: 120
  prefer_preemptible: true
  kv_cache_enabled: true
```

sam: Measurement hooks: we need per-route token accounting, per-tenant p95/p99 latencies, model-switch delta, and a quality regression alert when eval score delta > 1%. Add tracing and synthetic traffic for worst-case tails.

erin: Prioritization vote: please react :+1: to pick latency-first + embeddings-efficiency, :heart: to pick latency-first + rerank-SLA, :eyes: to request a third round of tradeoffs. I'll tally by EOD Fri.

pm-bot: Calendar invite created: "Hosted scenario planning review" Fri 10:00am. Invite includes deck link: https://redwoodhq/drive/hosted-scenario-q2

anya: Quick ask for sales ops: can we surface a simple procurement SKU for "Latency Tier" vs "Efficiency Tier" for Dedicated contracts? Sales needs price bands to close Nexus/Acme.

devin: To land the latency experiment we need commit from finance for 6-week GPU burn for infra work. Can we get signoff?

erin: I'll loop in finance + sales. Adding FIN-approve task.

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline: hosted/canary-variant created (ref: canary-2026-04), note: automated rollback enabled.

alex: One more operational guard: fallback model variants must be compatible with tokenizer and function-calling hooks. Add compatibility matrix to the rollout doc.

sam: If we do latency-first, recommend canary customers be those with short context chat usage (<=512 tokens) to minimize regression risk.

erin: Thanks all — next steps: everyone add any missing constraints by tomorrow, I'll close vote on Fri, then we draft a decision doc and start tickets for infra + evals. :rocket:
